description: Figure 4 is a line plot that compares the Macro-F1 scores of two models, "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information," as the number of tokens used for training varies. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)", is also a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot displays two lines: a pink line with circular markers representing "MATTER (ours)" and a purple line with circular markers representing "w/o material information." The "MATTER (ours)" line starts at a Macro-F1 score of approximately 55% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of about 58% at 1.0 tokens, and then declines to approximately 50% at 1.4 tokens. The "w/o material information" line starts at a score of about 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of approximately 53.5% at 1.0 tokens, and then declines to about 48% at 1.4 tokens. The shaded regions around each line represent the confidence intervals.
